summary: ProQR Therapeutics N.V. filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement for an underwritten registered direct offering of 27,624,310 ordinary shares at $1.81 per share, and a concurrent private placement of 5,100,780 shares to Eli Lilly at the same price. The combined expected net proceeds are ~$55.7 million, with closing expected June 26, 2026. The offering is a routine capital-raising transaction under an existing shelf registration statement. This is not a special situation; it is an ordinary equity offering. No special-situation categories apply.
